caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical object, resembling a candlestick holder, placed centrally within a lightly outlined square. The object is rendered in grayscale, showing shading and highlights that suggest a metallic material. It has a straight, vertical cylinder as the main body, with a slightly wider, flat circular base attached to the bottom, and a flat lid on top with a small, vertical handle or stub at its center. Attached to the left side of the base is a circular, upright handle. The overall composition is placed on a beige or light tan background, with the main drawing occupying the central portion of the paper. In the lower right corner, there is a smaller, detailed line drawing of the same object seen from the side, which includes measurements written in small script. The large square and smaller inset drawing are both outlined with fine lines.
